title: Unit – 4 : Session – 6 : SLO – 1  |  Expression Tree
sections: An EXPRESSION TREE is a binary tree representing arithmetic expressions.
The LEAVES of an expression tree are operands.
The INTERNAL NODES of an expression tree are operators.
The INORDER traversal of an expression tree gives the infix expression.
The POSTORDER traversal of an expression tree gives the postfix expression.
II. Expression Tree for: a + (b * c) + d * (e + f)
Inorder (infix):  a + b * c + d * e + f
Postorder (postfix): a b c * d e f + * + +
